evidence.field: Summary; source attribution; licensing; file history
evidence.text: The exact file page describes 期-seal.svg as a modern vector depicting 期 in Shuowen seal-script style, points to the S04924 image on hanziyuan.net as its source, and dates the current file version to 3 January 2015. Its licensing section releases the SVG representation to the public domain, internationally and for any purpose; attribution is appreciated but not required. The file’s labels support identifying it as a redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:期-seal.svg

evidence.source: Baxter and Sagart, official project table
evidence.field: GSR 0952a and 0952k; MC and OC columns
evidence.text: The version 1.1 table (20 September 2014) records 其 as MC gi, OC *gə (modal particle and third-person possessive entries), and 期 as MC gi, OC *[g](r)ə (‘period of time’). These are distinct OC notations in one system. The pair is compatible with a sound relationship but does not alone prove the phonetic role in the compound graph.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

evidence.text: The supplied local rows give 其 qí (U+5176), 期 qī (U+671F), and 朞 jī (U+671E). These are current Mandarin readings, not evidence of an ancient sound relationship. The official character-specific Unihan pages could not be opened in this run, so the values are local table data rather than externally verified character-specific records.

search_audit.outcome: Inspected both rows in the PDF: 其 is gi / *gə and 期 is gi / *[g](r)ə in the Baxter–Sagart table.

gaps: Unicode character-specific Unihan pages for 其 (U+5176), 期 (U+671F), and 朞 (U+671E) were inaccessible. Current Mandarin readings are reported from the supplied local exact rows, not as independently verified official page content.

The browser could not render or inspect the exact Commons SVG pixels. Revise alt text to describe only verified visible shapes after the separate visual inspection; do not assert components based only on the Commons labels.
Baxter–Sagart’s shared MC gi and similar but distinct OC reconstructions are compatible with a phonetic relationship; they do not by themselves establish the graph’s phonetic role.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; the file page does not independently date the represented form
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as 期 in Shuowen seal-script style. The file page identifies its source image as S04924; the represented form is not independently dated here.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style glyph centered on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The exact file page identifies this modern redraw as a Shuowen seal-script-style form of 期 and provides its source and reuse terms. It can illustrate that dictionary tradition, while neither the pixels nor their component analysis were independently verified in this research pass.
items.rights: Public domain according to the file page; attribution is appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: The original SVG could not be visually inspected through the browser. This seal-script-style candidate does not resolve the dating or relationship among 日-bearing and 月-bearing forms.
